notes: Safer and fairer: connecting Google Drive on a new phone no longer replaces your old backup before you restore it. Changing your plan no longer resets the weekly streak you already earned. Weight-trend tips are right even if you weigh in only a few times. Weighted pull-ups and dips stay in calisthenics plans, swapping an exercise no longer carries over the old weight, and the coach reads the equipment you mention (in English or Arabic, including "I don't have...") correctly.
